annotation.bound_parties_text: The draft standard specifies safety requirements for the design and construction of autonomous agricultural soil-working machinery and guidance on information the manufacturer must provide on safe working practices.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: Additionally, it provides guidance on the type of information to be provided by the manufacturer on safe working practices (including information about residual risks).
annotation.robot_provision_quote: Agricultural machinery and tractors — Safety of autonomous machinery — Part 1: Soil-Working Machinery
